usages.explain: Expresses the idea that the problem will be solved naturally or can be solved by some method.

examples.content: そんなに緊張しなくても、どうにかなるよ。
examples.transcription: そんなにきんちょうしなくても、どうにかなるよ。
examples.mean: You don't have to be so nervous, everything will be okay.

examples.content: 大丈夫、部長に頼めばどうにかなるよ
examples.transcription: だいじょうぶ、ぶちょうにたのめばどうにかなるよ
examples.mean: It's okay, just ask the manager and we'll take care of it.

title: どうにかなる => somehow manage do something about
